cause: The native source maps RINEX system characters S (SBAS) and I (NavIC), but the Phase69 diagnostic helper only mapped G/R/E/C/J. A non-adopted source system row must be consumed and skipped rather than treated as malformed input.

fixture_requirements: RINEX3 S-system row is consumed without a matching signal stream
RINEX3 long G-system record remains correctly framed
unsupported signal is skipped only after its physical record is consumed
